        robot.SetMotorSpeed(0, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)

    # Increment time counter
    time += time_step

    # Render the scene

import pychrono as chrono

system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))  # Set gravity in negative Z direction
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create ground body as terrain plane that robot will drive on

ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.6))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin (adjusted)
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# Create Turtlebot Robot
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.2, 0)  # Initial position of the robot
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)  # Initial orientation of the robot
robot = turtlebot.TurtleBot(system, init_pos, init_rot)  # Create Turtlebot instance
robot.Initialize()  # Initialize the robot

# Create sensor manager and attach to system
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)

# Create and configure lidar sensor
lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(robot.GetChassisBody(), 30, 0.1, 100, 0, 360, 1, 10, 0.1)
lidar.SetName("Lidar Sensor")
lidar.SetOffsetPose(chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.3)))  # Slightly above the robot chassis
lidar.SetPointCloudMaxRange(10)
lidar.SetHorizontalResolution(360)
lidar.SetVerticalResolution(1)
lidar.SetScanFrequency(10)
lidar.SetRotationFrequency(10)
lidar.SetNoiseStdDev(0.01)
lidar.SetVerticalFOV(0)  # Single layer lidar

# Add filters to lidar
# 1. Point cloud to XYZRGBA
pc_filter = sens.ChFilterPCtoXYZRGBA()
lidar.PushFilter(pc_filter)
# 2. Save point cloud to PCD file (optional, here commented out)
# save_filter = sens.ChFilterPCtoFile("lidar_output.pcd")
# lidar.PushFilter(save_filter)

manager.AddSensor(lidar)

# Add randomly placed boxes for interaction
np.random.seed(42)  # For reproducibility
num_boxes = 5
for i in range(num_boxes):
    size_x = 0.2
    size_y = 0.2
    size_z = 0.2
    density = 1000
    box_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
    box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(size_x, size_y, size_z, density, True, True, box_mat)
    # Random position within a 5x5 area around origin, height just above ground
    pos_x = np.random.uniform(-2.5, 2.5)
    pos_y = np.random.uniform(-2.5, 2.5)
    pos_z = size_z / 2  # Half height above ground
    box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(pos_x, pos_y, pos_z))
    box.SetMass(density * size_x * size_y * size_z)
    box.SetBodyFixed(False)
    system.Add(box)

# Create run-time visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Turtlebot Robot - Rigid terrain with Lidar and Boxes')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1.5, 0.2), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.2))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 2e-3

# Define WheelID enum values for motor control outside the loop
LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL = 0
RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL = 1

# Define motion control function for Turtlebot
def move(mode):
    """
    Control the Turtlebot movement.
    mode: 'straight', 'left', 'right'
    """
    speed = math.pi  # rad/s, example speed
    if mode == 'straight':
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(speed, LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(speed, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
    elif mode == 'left':
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(speed, LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(-speed, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
    elif mode == 'right':
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(-speed, LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(speed, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
    else:
        # Stop
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(0, LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(0, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    # Use move('straight') for Turtlebot movement
    move('straight')

    # Update sensor manager
    manager.Update()

    # Increment time counter
    time += time_step

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance the simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import math

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set

# Create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set gravity
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects

# Create the ground body (rigid terrain)
ground = chrono.ChBody()
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
ground_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape()
ground_shape.GetBoxGeometry().Size = chrono.ChVectorD(10, 10, 0.1)
ground.AddAsset(ground_shape)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -0.1))
system.Add(ground)

# Add a visual texture to ground for better visualization
ground_texture = chrono.ChTexture()
ground_texture.SetTextureFilename(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "textures/concrete.jpg")
ground.AddAsset(ground_texture)

# Initialize the Turtlebot robot
# PyChrono does not have a built-in Turtlebot model, so we will create a simplified Turtlebot-like robot:
# - A box chassis
# - Two cylindrical wheels on left and right
# - Motors controlling the wheels

# Chassis
chassis = chrono.ChBody()
chassis.SetMass(5)
chassis.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
chassis.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.15))  # Initial position (x=0,y=0,z=0.15)
chassis.SetRot(chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.radians(0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1)))  # Initial orientation (yaw=0)
system.Add(chassis)

# Left wheel
wheel_radius = 0.05
wheel_width = 0.02
wheel_mass = 1

left_wheel = chrono.ChBody()
left_wheel.SetMass(wheel_mass)
left_wheel.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.001, 0.001, 0.001))
left_wheel.SetPos(chassis.GetPos() + chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.1, wheel_radius))
left_wheel.SetRot(chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.radians(0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1)))
system.Add(left_wheel)

left_wheel_shape = chrono.ChCylinderShape()
left_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p1 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, -wheel_width/2, 0)
left_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p2 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, wheel_width/2, 0)
left_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().rad = wheel_radius
left_wheel.AddAsset(left_wheel_shape)

# Right wheel
right_wheel = chrono.ChBody()
right_wheel.SetMass(wheel_mass)
right_wheel.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.001, 0.001, 0.001))
right_wheel.SetPos(chassis.GetPos() + chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.1, wheel_radius))
right_wheel.SetRot(chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.radians(0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1)))
system.Add(right_wheel)

right_wheel_shape = chrono.ChCylinderShape()
right_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p1 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, -wheel_width/2, 0)
right_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p2 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, wheel_width/2, 0)
right_wheel_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().rad = wheel_radius
right_wheel.AddAsset(right_wheel_shape)

# Connect wheels to chassis with revolute joints (allow rotation around wheel axis)
# Wheel axis is along Y axis (since cylinder axis is Y)

# Left wheel joint
left_wheel_joint = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
left_wheel_joint.Initialize(left_wheel, chassis, chrono.ChCoordsysD(left_wheel.GetPos(), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.pi/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0))))
system.Add(left_wheel_joint)

# Right wheel joint
right_wheel_joint = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
right_wheel_joint.Initialize(right_wheel, chassis, chrono.ChCoordsysD(right_wheel.GetPos(), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.pi/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0))))
system.Add(right_wheel_joint)

# Add motors to control wheels
left_motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()
left_motor.Initialize(left_wheel, chassis, chrono.ChFrameD(left_wheel.GetPos(), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.pi/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0))))
system.Add(left_motor)

right_motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()
right_motor.Initialize(right_wheel, chassis, chrono.ChFrameD(right_wheel.GetPos(), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(math.pi/2, chrono.ChVectorD(0,1,0))))
system.Add(right_motor)

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions

# Create Irrlicht application for real-time visualization
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "Turtlebot Simulation", chronoirr.dimension2du(1024, 768))

# Add typical elements
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0.5, -1.5, 0.5))  # Camera position behind and above robot

# Bind assets and update all
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# Simulation parameters
timestep = 0.01
application.SetTimestep(timestep)

# Motor speed commands (rad/s)
# We'll define a simple control logic:
# - 0 to 3 seconds: go straight (both wheels same speed)
# - 3 to 6 seconds: turn left (left wheel slower, right wheel faster)
# - 6 to 9 seconds: turn right (left wheel faster, right wheel slower)
# - 9+ seconds: stop

def get_motor_speeds(time):
    base_speed = 10  # rad/s
    if time < 3:
        return base_speed, base_speed
    elif time < 6:
        return base_speed * 0.5, base_speed  # turn left
    elif time < 9:
        return base_speed, base_speed * 0.5  # turn right
    else:
        return 0, 0

# Simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    time = system.GetChTime()

    # Update motor speeds based on time
    left_speed, right_speed = get_motor_speeds(time)
    left_motor.SetSpeedFunction(chrono.ChFunction_Const(left_speed))
    right_motor.SetSpeedFunction(chrono.ChFunction_Const(right_speed))

    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()

    system.DoStepDynamics(timestep)

    elif mode == 'right':
        # Left wheel forward, right wheel stopped to turn right
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(math.pi, LEFT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
        robot.SetMotorSpeed(0, RIGHT_DRIVE_WHEEL)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid mode '{mode}'. Valid modes are 'straight', 'left', 'right'.")

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 2e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
current_mode = None

while vis.Run():
    # Determine mode based on time
    if time < 5.0:
        mode = 'straight'
    elif time < 10.0:
        mode = 'left'
    else:
        mode = 'right'

    # Change mode and print only when mode changes
    if mode != current_mode:
        current_mode = mode
        print(f"Time {time:.2f}s: Robot moving {mode}")
        move(mode)

    # Increment time counter
    time += time_step

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance the simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
